comments: Combines the two things that individually moved the needle: shallow_encoder (/4 bottleneck instead of /8, weight-shape-identical to the default architecture since stride isn't a learned parameter) initialized from the native-resolution checkpoint via train.py --finetune (verified: loads with strict=True, no shape mismatch), instead of random init. shallow_encoder alone lost to baseline from scratch (0.2887 vs 0.3070); finetune alone won on the full /8 architecture (0.3684). Tests whether a bottleneck with more spatial extent gives the finetuned features more to work with, or whether the /4 change still doesn't matter once initialization is fixed.
